query: How old is the world's oldest verified living person?

results.title: List of the verified oldest people - Wikipedia
results.content:
These are lists of the 100 known verified oldest people sorted in descending order by age in years and days. The oldest person ever whose age has been independently verified is Jeanne Calment (1875–1997) of France, who lived to the age of 122 years and 164 days. The oldest verified man ever is Jiroemon Kimura (1897–2013) of Japan, who lived to the age of 116 years and 54 days. [...] The oldest known living person is Ethel Caterham of the United Kingdom, aged 116 years, 349 days. The oldest known living man is João Marinho Neto of Brazil, aged 113 years, 304 days. The 100 oldest women have, on average, lived several years longer than the 100 oldest men.

results.title: Oldest living people - Gerontology Wiki - Fandom
results.content:
Since the death of 116-year-old Inah Canabarro Lucas of Brazil on 30 April 2025, 116-year-old Ethel Caterham of the UK is the oldest living person whose age is validated. There are currently 260 validated living supercentenarians by either the Gerontology Research Group (GRG) on the GRG World Supercentenarian Rankings List (WSRL), the Guinness World Records (GWR), or by LongeviQuest (LQ) on their list of oldest living people, whom 230 are female and 30 are male. results.title: Who is the oldest person in the world in 2024?
results.content:
Jeanne Louise Calment is the oldest verified person to have ever lived. The Frenchwoman lived to the ripe old age of 122 years and 164 days old. She was born on 21 February 1875 and passed away aged 122 on 4 August 1997. [...] # This is the oldest person in the world alive today

Find out who the oldest person alive is and see who else has worn the crown.

Sister Andre, Lucile Randon in the registry of birth, the eldest French and European citizen, prays in a wheelchair, on the eve of her 117th birthday

Photo credit: Getty

Toby Saunders

The verifiably oldest ever person in the world is Jeanne Louise Calment, who lived to the age of 122 years and 164 days old. [...] Today, the oldest person alive (as of August 2025), is the UK's Ethel Caterham. She is a sprightly 116 years, an age well beyond the average life expectancy of a human.

In the UK, the average life expectancy of a man is 78.8 years, and a woman 82.8 years, according to the Office for National Statistics. Expectancy is a bit lower in the US, with males expected to live 75.8 years, and women 81.1.
